{{Top|leg}}
A '''G-wave''' was a [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] wave, commonly emitted by [[Singularity (physics)|singularities]]. The [[collector-repulsor array]] developed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] focused G-waves produced by hundreds of low-yield [[repulsor projector]]s into a devastating field capable of disrupting [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] crusts. The array's G-wave output was comparable to a singularity, with the gravitational noise sufficient to hide [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Grav-bike/Legends|grav-bikes]] from detection.<ref name="Science">{{WEGCite|story=Ain't Science Grand?|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
